betterquesting:10.desc:8:
The View Cell is not what most people think it is. It does not display the contents of another cell. Instead, it filters what items appear in your terminal GUI.

Place a View Cell in a terminal's view cell slot and configure it with items. Only those items (or items matching the filter) will show up in the terminal. Add a Fuzzy Card for ore-dict matching, or an Inverter Card to show everything except the configured items.

Think of it as a search filter you can pre-set. Useful for terminals that only need to show a specific category of items, like a dedicated fluid terminal or a crafting-only view.

§ePS:§f View cells are configured the same way as storage cells: right-click to open the config GUI and add filter items.
